name: takaoumehara
description: Claude Code skills by Takao Umehara: multi-device pairing, product-development routing, interactive experiences, intuitive game design, session handoff, and repo hygiene.

plugins.name: snap-pair
plugins.description: Pair phones and screens by QR, PIN or broadcast and stream realtime input over Firebase, PartyKit, WebRTC or BroadcastChannel. Ships with the snap-pair-core npm package.

plugins.name: superforge-skills
plugins.description: One thin router chooses among fourteen product specialists (brain, biz, brand, UI, dev, test, debug, a11y, secure, verify, ship and more) and gates release behind verification.

plugins.name: interactive-experience-skills
plugins.description: Three design skills for work built on human movement, cameras and sensors: a director that first decides experience vs. training tool, plus specialists for installations and movement-learning systems.

plugins.name: intuitive-game-design
plugins.description: Design and build games a first-time player understands with no manual: intuition design and diagnosis, one-tap game feel, Web Audio, camera/body input, calm puzzles, multiplayer sync.

plugins.name: cross-model-handoff
plugins.description: Passphrase-based session handoff: write one note before /clear or a tool switch, resume by name in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Cursor or any AGENTS.md-aware tool.

plugins.name: repo-cleanup
plugins.description: Take a messy git working tree back to clean (untrack build output, complete .gitignore, sort changes into commit / stash / discard) without leaking a secret or losing uncommitted work.
